summary: The VP of Data Engineering is an executive leader responsible for the organization’s data engineering vision, strategy, and operations at a global or enterprise level.
responsibilities: Set the overall strategy and vision for data engineering
Oversee multiple data engineering divisions and enterprise platforms
Align data initiatives with organizational objectives and business strategy
Manage executive stakeholders and drive innovation in data capabilities
Ensure operational excellence, scalability, and security of all data systems

education: 15+ years of experience in data engineering, architecture, and leadership

skills_required.name: Deep expertise in big data, cloud platforms, analytics, and enterprise data architecture
Financial management, resource planning, and organizational leadership
Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement
